description: Watch-activity search contract (read-only). Translated from the adapter contract tests. 'pages' is what get_activities(start, limit) returns for each call in order; 'details' is what the per-activity chart parser returns. Page size is always 20; at most 10 pages.
algorithm: localStart = parse(startedAtUtc) as UTC; missing/unparseable => failed/provider (ValueError path).
for page in 0..9: activities = listActivities(start = page*20, limit = 20).
if activities is not a JSON array => emit failed/response (malformed) WITH the (possibly refreshed) tokenStore; stop.
if activities is empty => window complete; stop.
for each activity object: started = parse(startTimeGMT) as UTC (a naive value is UTC; accept 'T' or ' ' separator).
skip if activityId missing, started missing, or |started - localStart| > 600 s.
fetch chart details (maxChartSize=1000, maxPolylineSize=0); on any error use no samples (summary HR may still exist).

stride = max(1, ceil(n/200)); keep every stride-th parsed sample whose elapsed (sumElapsedDuration, else sumDuration) is numeric and bpm (directHeartRate, else heartRate) is numeric and 0 < bpm <= 255; bpm rounded to integer.

candidate = {remoteId: str(activityId), activityType: 'treadmill_running', startedAtUtc: ISO-8601 UTC, durationSeconds: duration or 0, distanceKilometers: (distance or 0)/1000, averageHeartRate: averageHR if finite and 0<x<=255 else null (keep decimals), maximumHeartRate: maxHR rounded to integer if finite and 0<x<=255 else null, heartRateSamples}.
if 6 candidates collected => stop collecting (6th is the overflow marker).
if 6 candidates or this page had fewer than 20 items => window complete; stop.
if the page's oldest parsed start < localStart - 600 s => window complete; stop (pages are newest-first).
if the loop ran out of pages without completing => emit failed/search-window-truncated WITH tokenStore.

Host-side bounds (fail closed as an ambiguous read => retryable read failure): more than 5 candidates, any candidate with more than 200 HR samples, tokenStore longer than 32 768 characters, response line longer than 65 536 characters.
